The climate in Razgrad

Razgrad is about 200 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 30°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −2°C. Around 670 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in June (about 91 mm).

Razgrad lies in the Ludogorie, a hilly plateau in north-eastern Bulgaria, on the Beli Lom river. The climate is moderate continental, with warm summers and cold, sometimes snowy winters with north-easterly winds. The plateau is open, so temperatures change quickly when cold or warm air arrives.
